text:
alex: heads up — main CI just went red immediately after merging #3473. smoke suite timing out in smoke-e2e/shard-4. https://ci.redwood.dev/builds/5678 :grimacing:
maria: ugh, who owns the smoke suite today?
sam: last green was before the kvcache changes in #3473 — pinging @ryan who reviewed it
ci-bot: [BUILD 5678] smoke-e2e/shard-4 — FAILED — timeout after 30m (logs: https://ci.redwood.dev/builds/5678/logs)
ryan: on it, grabbing logs now
ryan: seeing repeated "connection refused" to dev-kv-proxy from the smoke runner at 00:12, 00:13, 00:14
alex: hmm that sounds infray. did the merge touch infra flags? #3473 was mostly kvcache + quantization toggles
maria: if this is infra, we should revert quickly to restore main. can we try a quick rerun first?
sam: rerun is cheap, but if it's a systemic connect failure it'll fail again. I can start a bisect if reruns are flaky
ci-bot: rerun triggered by alex — BUILD 5679 queued
ci-bot: [BUILD 5679] smoke-e2e/shard-4 — RUNNING
ryan: repro on local smoke runner too — connector attempts hit 503s for ~2m then succeed, then eventually get killed by timeout
alex: timeline: if 5679 doesn't pass in 10m, i'm going to open a revert PR for #3473 and roll it back. We need main green for demos later
maria: +1. also posting incident note in #incidents in case this impacts staging rolling tests
ci-bot: [BUILD 5679] smoke-e2e/shard-4 — FAILED — timeout after 30m
sam: yup systemic. please do the revert. i'll stand by to bisect once main is stable
ryan: creating revert PR now — will link here
ryan: revert PR opened: https://git.redwood.dev/redwood/repo/pull/3480 — includes revert + changelog note
alex: thanks. @ci-bot can you trigger a smoke run against the revert branch when CI picks it up?
ci-bot: [PR 3480] CI will run on push. Build queued: 5685
ci-bot: [BUILD 5685] smoke-e2e/shard-4 — RUNNING
maria: nice. if 5685 passes, we can merge and cut a hotfix deploy. keep me posted
ci-bot: [BUILD 5685] smoke-e2e/shard-4 — PASSED
alex: merged revert PR 3480 and promoted. Rolling deploy started to canary
ryan: can confirm smoke passes on canary nodes, kv-proxy errors gone in the logs
sam: great. i'll follow up with a bisect plan for the kvcache changes so we can reintroduce safely
maria: thanks everyone for the quick turnaround. postmortem follow-up: add a smoke guard and kv-proxy health check to the smoke suite :memo:
alex: agreed — assigning follow-ups. closing this thread once postmortem is drafted. :thumbsup:
